attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kentucky military retirement exemption (2025). Flat $31,110 exemption (matches general pension exclusion). SBP payments receive same treatment. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, KY DOR. Skeleton — see issue #446.

condition_details.condition_comment: The taxpayer has military retired pay, a federal pension (Form 740 packet: Federal and Military Retirement Systems, taxable, Schedule P)

Full-year resident entry only. A part-year or nonresident entry's income is built from the income entities, so the pension is not in it, and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars a state from taxing a nonresident's retirement income (#1330 review).

action_details.action_comment: Schedule M line 9 / Schedule P Part II: 100% of taxable retirement benefits or $31,110, whichever is less, per taxpayer (KRS 141.019(1)(g)1.b)
action_details.action_dsl: add the minimum of taxpayer.military_retirement_pay and ky_pension_exclusion to result.ky_military_retirement_exemption
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.military_retirement_pay ky_pension_exclusion fmin cvd result.ky_military_retirement_exemption f+ /result.ky_military_retirement_exemption xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: Kentucky has no military-specific exemption; military retired pay for service after 1997 takes the general pension income exclusion, the lesser of the pay and $31,110 per taxpayer (Schedule M line 9; Schedule P Part II line 3; KRS 141.019(1)(g)1.b; 2025 Form 740 packet). Service credit before 1998 would be exempt in full on Schedule P Part I and is not modelled.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Kentucky has no military-specific exemption; military retired pay for service after 1997 takes the general pension income exclusion, the lesser of the pay and $31,110 per taxpayer (Schedule M line 9; Schedule P Part II line 3; KRS 141.019(1)(g)1.b; 2025 Form 740 packet). Service credit before 1998 would be exempt in full on Schedule P Part I and is not modelled."

policy_statement.policy_description: No military retired pay for this taxpayer.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No military retired pay for this taxpayer."

policy_statement.policy_description: Not a full-year resident entry: the pension is not in this entry's sourced income (the roster builds it from the income entities) and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars taxing a nonresident's retirement income, so nothing is subtracted.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Not a full-year resident entry: the pension is not in this entry's sourced income (the roster builds it from the income entities) and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars taxing a nonresident's retirement income, so nothing is subtracted."

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kentucky state income tax. Flat 4.00% rate (KRS 141.020, 2025) on AGI minus $3,270 standard deduction (same for all filing statuses). Writes result.ky_taxable_income and result.ky_state_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.ky_state_tax = 0; set result.ky_taxable_income = 0; add " Kentucky Tax Calculation (Form 740) - flat 4.00%" to job.audit_trail; set result.ky_military_retirement_exemption = 0.0; perform ky_military_retirement_exemption; add " KY Schedule M line 9 pension income exclusion (military retired pay): $" + result.ky_military_retirement_exemption to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.ky_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ky_taxable_income xdef " Kentucky Tax Calculation (Form 740) - flat 4.00%" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 cvd /result.ky_military_retirement_exemption xdef /ky_military_retirement_exemption performtable " KY Schedule M line 9 pension income exclusion (military retired pay): $" result.ky_military_retirement_exemption strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Always compute (single-column FIRST table; deduction is uniform)

action_details.action_comment: Form 740: Kentucky AGI (line 9) is federal AGI less Schedule M subtractions, here the pension income exclusion; less the $3,270 standard deduction (line 10); tax 4% (line 12)
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ky_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.ky_military_retirement_exemption - ky_standard_deduction) and 0.0; set result.ky_state_tax = result.ky_taxable_income * ky_tax_rate; add " KY taxable income (AGI - $3,270): $" + result.ky_taxable_income to job.audit_trail; add " KY state tax (4.00%): $" + result.ky_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.ky_military_retirement_exemption f- ky_standard_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ky_taxable_income xdef result.ky_taxable_income ky_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.ky_state_tax xdef " KY taxable income (AGI - $3,270): $" result.ky_taxable_income strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " KY state tax (4.00%): $" result.ky_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.ky_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.ky_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.ky_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.ky_state_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: KY flat tax: 4.00% x max(AGI - pension income exclusion (Schedule M line 9, up to $31,110 per taxpayer, applied to military retired pay) - $3,270, 0).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "KY flat tax: 4.00% x max(AGI - pension income exclusion (Schedule M line 9, up to $31,110 per taxpayer, applied to military retired pay) - $3,270, 0)."
